# cliprobe

```go
import "github.com/kitsunium/sdk/framework/kit/testdata/cliprobe"
```

Command cliprobe is the smallest product a status line is: one service, one default fail\-safe command that writes a line. The fresh\-process benchmark of framework/kit builds and runs it.

## Variables

<a name="App"></a>App is the probe's app.

```go
var App = kit.NewApp("cliprobe", Line)
```

<a name="Line"></a>Line is the probe's only service.

```go

```
